name: Reference Path Tracing
definition: A multi-scatter volumetric path tracer used as a ground-truth reference renderer. It traces full random walks through the medium with next-event estimation (NEE) at each scattering vertex and uses Russian roulette to terminate long paths unbiasedly.
summary: Reference Path Tracing is an unbiased volumetric path tracer that provides ground-truth accuracy for subsurface scattering by performing full random walks, explicitly tracking geometric features for accurate shadowing.
